the CS of PNe interacting and non-interacting with the ISMs have very similar physical properties.

(i) the CSPN of PNe interacting strongly with the ISM are more massive than the average of non-interacting PNe, (ii) the effective temperature of CSPN in interacting PNe is on average lower than that of non-interacting ones, (iii) the chemical abundances of interacting PNe are similar to those of non-interacting objects, (iv) the CSPN are more evolved than those of non-interaction PNe.

the majority of the analyzed CS are hydrogen deficient and have strong CNO overabundances.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the analysis of PNe interacting the ISM is more complex than for non-interacting PNe.
the NLTE analysis of the CSPNe is essential to obtain reliable stellar and wind parameters.
